findingsCorrected.location: SKILL.md: investigation workflow; execution contracts; context and security
findingsCorrected.finding: A stage's executor and a request's context need distinct, per-edge ownership; registration, submission and execution may occur on different callers.
findingsCorrected.consequence: Tracing only a similar chain or assuming executor inheritance/capture at graph construction can misdiagnose the actual continuation.
findingsCorrected.fix: Follow caller-visible factories/classes/wrappers and every continuation; state per-edge executor and request-context capture at registration.

findingsCorrected.finding: For base CompletableFuture, an explicit executor on one edge is not inherited by later executor-less Async edges.
findingsCorrected.fix: Explain base behavior and subclass exceptions using defaultExecutor/newIncompleteFuture with Java 17 API/source references.

findingsCorrected.finding: OpenTelemetry Java 1.55.0 Context.taskWrapping captures at Executor.execute. Deferred CompletableFuture submission may happen under the provider's context.
findingsCorrected.fix: Bind request-owned context before continuation registration and restore previous MDC/OTel context on inline/queued success/failure; avoid binding every request to one singleton executor context.
